rec.name: PDP Shop the Look / Complete the Look (Outfit Cross-Sell)
rec.status: Reference only (competitor examples, no spec or build)

what.text: A fashion PDP cross-sell and up-sell module that shows the viewed product as part of a styled outfit and lets shoppers jump to, or add, the matching items. The ticket has only a title and five reference screenshots, which show several entry patterns: (1) an 'Der Look dazu' (The look for this) button overlaid on the product gallery; (2) a collapsed 'Mach deinen Look perfekt' (Perfect your look) bar with a thumbnail, placed between the price and the size selector; (3) an outfit slide inside the gallery carousel, with a product tag ('Elevated Icon Oxford Shi…') and a 'Look anzeigen' (Show look) button; (4) an 'Outfit-Inspiration / Trage es mit' (Wear it with) block with a large styled photo, a 'View outfit (3)' button and a column of item thumbnails; (5) a desktop 'SHOP THE LOOK' section with a large look image on the left and, on the right, a list of items with name, price, color swatches and a 'Größe wählen' (Select size) button.

why.text: Fashion shoppers buy outfits, not single items. Showing a styled look reduces the effort of deciding what goes with the product and prompts additional purchases, which raises items per order and AOV. A lifestyle or model image adds inspiration and social proof of how the item is worn. A collapsed teaser or gallery button keeps the main purchase path uncluttered, so the cross-sell does not compete with the primary add-to-cart.

how.text: Build it as a PDP section or app block fed by a curated 'look' per product, for example a product-list metafield or a metaobject holding the look image plus 2-4 linked products. Render the look in the format that fits the page: on desktop, a look image with an item list (image, title, price, color swatches, size-select/add button); on mobile, a gallery slide or button that opens a drawer or anchor, or a collapsed teaser bar with a thumbnail that expands. Each item needs variant selection (size) before add-to-cart. Optionally add an 'Add all to cart' action and fall back to automatic recommendations (same collection or tag) when no look is curated. The ticket gives no build detail, so this is inferred from the screenshots.

items: Entry-point style: gallery overlay button / collapsed teaser bar / dedicated section / gallery slide
Section heading and button labels (e.g. 'Shop the Look', 'Complete the look', 'View outfit')
Look source: manual metafield/metaobject vs automatic recommendations
Show color swatches and price per item
Per-item size selector and add-to-cart vs link to PDP
Look image position (left/right) and mobile layout (stacked / slide / drawer)
Optional model/creator label and item-count badge on the CTA

dependencies.text: Needs curated look data (product-list metafield or metaobject with look image and linked products) or a recommendations app. Needs variant and swatch data on the linked products, and a theme with a PDP gallery or section slot. Cart add via AJAX Cart API is recommended for in-place size selection. Nothing is specified in the ticket.

items: Click-through rate on look entry point
PDP-to-cart conversion rate (guard against distraction from the main CTA)

images.caption: 'Der Look dazu' button overlaid on the PDP gallery (mobile), as an entry point to the outfit.
Collapsed 'Mach deinen Look perfekt' bar with a thumbnail between price and size selector, keeping the main add-to-cart flow intact.
Outfit slide inside the gallery carousel, with a product tag and a 'Look anzeigen' button.
'Outfit-Inspiration / Trage es mit' block: styled photo with a creator label, a 'View outfit (3)' CTA and item thumbnails.
Desktop 'SHOP THE LOOK' layout: look image on the left, item list with price, swatches and 'Größe wählen' buttons on the right.
